record.reason: VIGILant mitigates visual laziness in multimodal LLMs through counterfactual visual alignment. The method improves visual grounding; it is not presented as a compute or latency reduction, so the connection to inference efficiency is indirect.
record.title: Staying VIGILant: Mitigating Visual Laziness via Counterfactual Visual Alignment in MLLMs
